desc: We are excited to release the CobraTec Raptor. The Raptor has been engineered, designed and tested to offer a lifetime of use. There is no doubt that the Raptor is in a class of its own. The handle is CNC machined out of 6061-T6 and each part is designed with precision, making this Raptor one of the smoothest performing OTF knives you will find in the market place today.
